title: Design WhatsApp
description: Design a real-time chat service with one-to-one and bounded group messaging, offline delivery and media references.
functionalRequirements: Deliver messages after reconnection with per-conversation ordering
Upload media separately and send access-controlled references
Track delivery acknowledgements; typing and presence are extensions
nonFunctionalRequirements: Online text delivery server p95 below 200 ms within a region
Do not acknowledge acceptance before durable message storage
constraints: 10 million DAU sending 40 text messages each per day; use a 5x peak multiplier
Assume two recipient deliveries per sent message on average; groups are capped at 256 members
Use 300 bytes per stored text message and a 30-day server retention exercise window
outOfScope: Cryptographic protocol design; treat end-to-end encrypted payloads as opaque if requested

scale.assumption: Synthetic interview workload, not a claim about any named company's actual traffic.
notes: Workload assumptions describe a practice system, not WhatsApp traffic.
Recipient delivery volume includes average group fanout but excludes retries; budget retry headroom separately.
Media objects, indexes and device copies are excluded from the text byte estimate.
